name: markdown-catalog-editor
description: A Markdown editor for a local folder of notes — one standalone HTML file, a PWA that opens .md files, and Markdown Knowledge Base, a Chrome extension that sends what you select to your notes

scripts.test: node tools/test-blocks.mjs && node tools/test-format.mjs && node tools/test-table.mjs && node tools/test-markdown.mjs && node tools/test-meta.mjs && node tools/test-vault.mjs && node tools/test-zip.mjs && node tools/test-export.mjs && node tools/test-clip.mjs && node tools/test-i18n.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:editor && npm run test:convert && npm run test:pwa && npm run test:extension
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
